docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Six lectures given at the Royal Institution for a young audience, with experiments: gravity, cohesion and adhesion, chemical affinity, heat, magnetism and electricity, and the relations that bind these forces to each other. Edited by William Crookes.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Michael Faraday (1791–1867), A Course of Six Lectures on the Various Forces of Matter and Their Relations to Each Other, edited by William Crookes (1832–1919), London, 1860; text from Wikisource. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
